The Green Party (SZ) leadership election of 2024''' was held on 2 November 2024. Both  and Matěj Pomahač ran unopposed and thus were elected.
Background and election
Co-chairman Michal Berg resigned after party poor result in the 2024 European Parliament election, the party received 1.55%. Co-chairman Magdalena Davis resigned after poor party result in the 2024 Czech regional elections, the party defended only one mandate out of seven.
